name: @solara/solaracore
description: The web engine for React Native macOS via Expo Modules: Chrome's own framework from our patched Chromium with our layer (engine/solaracore), hosting Chrome tabs in the app's views.

scripts.test: clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-zoom.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-zoom-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-zoom-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-throw.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-throw-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-pip-throw-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror -framework Foundation tests/tab-strip-observers.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-tab-strip-observers-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-tab-strip-observers-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror -framework AppKit tests/escape-key.test.mm -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-escape-key-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/solaracore-escape-key-test" && node --test tests/page-calls.test.mjs
